spacebar.qualification: Digital sliding geometry and parallel guidance; force, friction and rattle require physical testing.

chassis.clamp_concept: four custom double-ended M3 standoffs; nonoverlapping top and bottom screw insertion zones
chassis.qualification: Resolved nominal grip path. Threads are specified analytical hardware envelopes, not helical mating meshes or preload qualification.
